name: Ranger R8SS-3D panel radar (FLIR)
description: Compact perimeter panel radar; tracks up to 500 targets and cues EO/IR. Micro-UAS to 2-3 km per 120 deg face.

rangeAccuracyM.condition: range accuracy ±3 m (vendor bound taken as 1 sigma)
rangeAccuracyM.source: Teledyne FLIR Ranger R8SS-3D datasheet (mirror at cctv-systems.se; the flir.com URL returned 404 on 2026-09-10)

falseAlarmRatePerScan.note: Planning factor: PLACARD_PFA 1e-6 (src/model/types.ts) times about 1e6 range-azimuth-Doppler cells per scan of a 360° surveillance volume gives about one false alarm per scan over the whole coverage; this 90° sector panel searches about half the cells and is recorded at 0.5. No vendor publishes a false-alarm rate.

dwellTimeS.note: Planning factor: Teledyne FLIR publishes no dwell or CPI. An electronically scanned radar sets its dwell in the beam schedule rather than by beamwidth over scan rate; the literature CPI of 20 ms for X/Ku-band drone-detection AESAs is used. Open literature on X/Ku-band drone-detection AESAs gives a CPI of about 20 ms at 5 kHz PRF (about 100 pulses; arXiv 2307.10326) and about 30 ms at 6 kHz (about 180 pulses; MDPI Drones 7(5):316), and notes that a 2.7 ms dwell barely resolves micro-Doppler. The R8SS-3D sheet gives a 2 or 4 Hz electronic scan rate over a 90° sector and no dwell. The sheet states X-band, where this record says Ku; see the changelog open item.

pulsesPerDwell.note: Planning factor: Teledyne FLIR publishes no PRF or pulse count. 20 ms dwell at the literature 5 kHz PRF gives 100 pulses coherently integrated. Open literature on X/Ku-band drone-detection AESAs gives a CPI of about 20 ms at 5 kHz PRF (about 100 pulses; arXiv 2307.10326) and about 30 ms at 6 kHz (about 180 pulses; MDPI Drones 7(5):316), and notes that a 2.7 ms dwell barely resolves micro-Doppler. The R8SS-3D sheet gives a 2 or 4 Hz electronic scan rate over a 90° sector and no dwell. The sheet states X-band, where this record says Ku; see the changelog open item.
